desc: This is a lightweight, headless browser purpose-built for AI agents (such as Codex or Claude Code) to perform browser automation tasks; it is designed to navigate through various web protection systems, login processes, and reverse-engineering scenarios
Search inside documents, code, and even screenshots - instantly and locally. A free, open-source file launcher with OCR, semantic search, and MCP agent access.

EveryInfra MCP server & agent plugin: scraper API for TikTok, Instagram, Amazon, YouTube, Xiaohongshu & Douyin. 573 data APIs across 106 platforms, from $0.56/1K calls. For Claude Code, Cursor, Codex.

Edit photos by describing the change, on your own GPU. A free, open-source alternative to Nano Banana and ChatGPT image editing: photos stay on your computer, no daily limit. One installer for Windows, Mac and Linux sets up the best open model (Qwen-Image 2.1). MCP server for AI agents.
